indexes.unused_indexes: SELECT u.object_schema AS schema_name, u.object_name AS table_name, u.index_name, ROUND((stat.stat_value * @@innodb_page_size) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb FROM sys.schema_unused_indexes u JOIN mysql.innodb_index_stats stat ON u.object_schema = stat.database_name AND u.object_name = stat.table_name AND u.index_name = stat.index_name WHERE stat.stat_name = 'size' AND u.object_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY index_size_mb DESC;
indexes.redundant_indexes: SELECT r.table_schema AS schema_name, r.table_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.redundant_index_name ORDER BY r.redundant_index_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS redundant_indexes, MAX(r.dominant_index_name) AS dominant_index, MAX(r.redundant_index_columns) AS index_columns FROM sys.schema_redundant_indexes r WHERE r.table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') GROUP BY r.table_schema, r.table_name, r.redundant_index_columns ORDER BY r.table_schema, r.table_name;
indexes.queries_high_full_table_scans: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS schema_name, DIGEST_TEXT AS query_pattern, COUNT_STAR AS total_executions, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000000, 2) AS total_latency_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_latency_ms, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS full_table_scans, SUM_NO_GOOD_INDEX_USED AS bad_index_scans, ROUND((SUM_NO_INDEX_USED / COUNT_STAR) * 100, 2) AS full_scan_pct, FIRST_SEEN, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_NO_INDEX_USED DESC, SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;
indexes.low_selectivity_indexes: SELECT s.TABLE_SCHEMA AS schema_name, s.TABLE_NAME AS table_name, s.INDEX_NAME AS index_name, s.COLUMN_NAME AS column_name, s.CARDINALITY AS cardinality, t.TABLE_ROWS AS table_rows, ROUND((s.CARDINALITY / NULLIF(t.TABLE_ROWS, 0)) * 100, 2) AS selectivity_pct FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS s JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t ON s.TABLE_SCHEMA = t.TABLE_SCHEMA AND s.TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME WHERE s.TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND s.INDEX_NAME != 'PRIMARY' AND t.TABLE_ROWS > 0 HAVING selectivity_pct < 10.00 ORDER BY selectivity_pct ASC LIMIT 10;

users.account_password_hygiene: SELECT user, host, plugin AS auth_plugin, account_locked, password_expired, password_last_changed, password_lifetime, CASE WHEN authentication_string = '' OR authentication_string IS NULL THEN 'NO PASSWORD' WHEN password_lifetime IS NULL AND @@global.default_password_lifetime = 0 THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES (Global)' WHEN password_lifetime = 0 THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES (User-Level)' ELSE 'POLICY ENFORCED' END AS password_risk_status FROM mysql.user WHERE user NOT IN ('mysql.sys', 'mysql.session', 'mysql.infoschema') AND user NOT LIKE 'cloudsql%' ORDER BY password_risk_status DESC LIMIT 10;
users.excessive_administrative_privileges: SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE_TYPE, IS_GRANTABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USER_PRIVILEGES WHERE PRIVILEGE_TYPE IN ('SUPER', 'ALL PRIVILEGES', 'GRANT OPTION', 'SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN', 'RELOAD', 'SHUTDOWN') AND GRANTEE NOT LIKE "'mysql.%'" AND GRANTEE NOT LIKE "'root'@'localhost'" AND GRANTEE NOT LIKE "'cloudsql%'" ORDER BY GRANTEE LIMIT 10;

performance.full_table_scans: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS schema_name, DIGEST_TEXT AS query_pattern, COUNT_STAR AS total_executions, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000000, 2) AS total_latency_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_latency_ms, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS full_table_scans, SUM_NO_GOOD_INDEX_USED AS bad_index_scans, ROUND((SUM_NO_INDEX_USED / COUNT_STAR) * 100, 2) AS full_scan_pct, FIRST_SEEN, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_NO_INDEX_USED DESC LIMIT 15;
performance.temp_table_usage: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS schema_name, DIGEST_TEXT AS query_pattern, COUNT_STAR AS total_executions, SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES AS total_tmp_tables, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS total_tmp_disk_tables, ROUND((SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES / NULLIF(SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES, 0)) * 100, 2) AS disk_tmp_pct, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_latency_ms, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES DESC LIMIT 15;
performance.buffer_pool_hit_ratio: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests') AS total_read_requests, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') AS disk_reads, ROUND((1 - ((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'))) * 100, 2) AS buffer_pool_hit_ratio_pct;
performance.dirty_pages: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') AS dirty_pages_count, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') AS total_pages_count, ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') * 100, 2) AS dirty_page_pct;
performance.redo_log: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_waits') AS log_buffer_waits, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_write_requests') AS write_requests, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_writes') AS physical_writes, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_os_log_fsyncs') AS total_fsyncs;
performance.top_queries_by_execution_time: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS database_name, DIGEST_TEXT AS query, COUNT_STAR AS calls, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS total_ms, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND((SUM_TIMER_WAIT / (SELECT SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT) FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys') AND SCHEMA_NAME IS NOT NULL)) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_total_time, SUM_ROWS_SENT AS rows FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND SCHEMA_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%performance_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%information_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE 'SHOW%' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE 'SET %' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '/*!%' ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;

locks.lock_waits: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA AS schema_name, OBJECT_NAME AS table_name, COUNT_STAR AS total_lock_waits, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS total_wait_time_ms, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_wait_time_ms, ROUND(MAX_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS max_wait_time_ms FROM performance_schema.table_lock_waits_summary_by_table WHERE SUM_TIMER_WAIT > 0 AND OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;

connections.connections_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Max_used_connections') AS max_concurrent_connections_recorded, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'max_connections') AS configured_max_connections, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Max_used_connections') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'max_connections')) * 100, 2) AS max_connection_utilization_pct;
connections.thread_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_cached') AS cached_threads, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_created') AS total_threads_created, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_created') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS thread_miss_ratio_pct;
connections.aborted_connections_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects') AS total_aborted_connects_auth, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_clients') AS total_aborted_clients_network, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections') AS total_connection_attempts, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS abort_auth_pct, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_clients') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS abort_client_pct;

storage.table_fragmentation_status: SELECT table_schema AS schema_name, table_name, ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_size_mb, ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb, ROUND(data_free / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS fragmented_free_space_mb, ROUND((data_free / NULLIF(data_length + index_length + data_free, 0)) * 100, 2) AS fragmentation_pct FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND data_free > 0 ORDER BY fragmented_free_space_mb DESC LIMIT 15;

indexes.unused_indexes: SELECT s.schemaname AS schema_name, s.relname AS table_name, s.indexrelname AS index_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid)) AS index_size, s.idx_scan AS times_used FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s WHERE s.idx_scan = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = s.indexrelid AND (i.indisprimary OR i.indisunique)) AND s.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') ORDER BY pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) DESC LIMIT 10;
indexes.redundant_indexes: SELECT a.schemaname AS schema_name, a.tablename AS table_name, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.indexname, ', ' ORDER BY a.indexname) AS redundant_indexes, b.indexname AS dominant_index, a.indexdef AS index_columns FROM pg_indexes a JOIN pg_indexes b ON a.tablename = b.tablename AND a.indexname <> b.indexname AND a.schemaname = b.schemaname WHERE position(replace(a.indexdef, a.indexname, '') IN replace(b.indexdef, b.indexname, '')) > 0 AND a.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') GROUP BY a.schemaname, a.tablename, b.indexname, a.indexdef ORDER BY a.tablename;
indexes.queries_high_full_table_scans: SELECT relname AS table_name, seq_scan AS total_full_scans, seq_tup_read AS total_rows_read_via_scan, CASE WHEN seq_scan = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((seq_tup_read::numeric / seq_scan), 0) END AS avg_rows_per_scan, idx_scan AS total_index_scans, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS table_size FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE seq_scan > 0 ORDER BY seq_scan DESC LIMIT 10;
indexes.low_selectivity_indexes: SELECT database_name, table_name, column_name, n_distinct, correlation, estimated_selectivity_pct FROM (SELECT s.schemaname AS database_name, s.tablename AS table_name, s.attname AS column_name, s.n_distinct, s.correlation, CASE WHEN s.n_distinct > 0 THEN ROUND(((s.n_distinct / GREATEST(c.reltuples, 1)) * 100)::numeric, 2) WHEN s.n_distinct < 0 THEN ROUND((ABS(s.n_distinct) * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS estimated_selectivity_pct FROM pg_stats s JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = s.tablename JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = s.schemaname WHERE s.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND c.reltuples > 1000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes i WHERE i.tablename = s.tablename AND i.schemaname = s.schemaname AND position(s.attname IN i.indexdef) > 0)) sub WHERE estimated_selectivity_pct < 5 ORDER BY estimated_selectivity_pct ASC LIMIT 10;

users.account_password_hygiene: SELECT r.rolname AS username, r.rolcanlogin AS can_login, r.rolsuper AS is_superuser, r.rolinherit AS inherits_privileges, r.rolcreatedb AS can_create_db, r.rolcreaterole AS can_create_roles, r.rolvaliduntil AS password_expires_at, CASE WHEN r.rolvaliduntil IS NULL THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES' WHEN r.rolvaliduntil < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'POLICY ENFORCED' END AS password_risk_status FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND r.rolname NOT LIKE 'cloudsql%' AND r.rolcanlogin = true ORDER BY password_risk_status DESC LIMIT 10;
users.excessive_administrative_privileges: SELECT grantee, table_catalog AS database_name, privilege_type, is_grantable FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE privilege_type IN ('DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER') AND grantee NOT IN ('postgres') AND grantee NOT LIKE 'cloudsql%' ORDER BY grantee LIMIT 10;

performance.buffer_pool_hit_ratio: SELECT relname AS table_name, heap_blks_read AS blocks_read_from_disk, heap_blks_hit AS blocks_from_memory, CASE WHEN (heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((heap_blks_hit::numeric / (heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read)) * 100, 2) END AS buffer_hit_ratio_pct FROM pg_statio_user_tables WHERE (heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read) > 0 ORDER BY buffer_hit_ratio_pct ASC LIMIT 10;
performance.dirty_pages: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(count(*) * 8192) AS dirty_data_size, count(*) AS dirty_page_count, round(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM pg_buffercache WHERE isdirty), 0), 2) AS pct_of_total_dirty FROM pg_buffercache b JOIN pg_class c ON b.relfilenode = pg_relation_filenode(c.oid) JOIN pg_database d ON (b.reltablespace = d.dattablespace OR b.reltablespace = 0) AND d.datname = current_database() WHERE b.isdirty = true AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'm') GROUP BY c.relname ORDER BY dirty_page_count DESC;
performance.redo_log: SELECT pg_current_wal_lsn() AS current_wal_position, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), '0/0') AS total_wal_bytes_written, pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), '0/0')) AS total_wal_size, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_ls_waldir()) AS total_wal_files, pg_size_pretty((SELECT sum(size) FROM pg_ls_waldir())) AS total_wal_directory_size;
performance.temp_table_usage: SELECT datname AS database_name, temp_files AS temp_files_created, pg_size_pretty(temp_bytes) AS temp_data_written_to_disk, deadlocks, conflicts FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();
performance.top_queries_by_execution_time: SELECT query, calls, ROUND(total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS total_ms, ROUND(mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND((100 * total_exec_time / SUM(total_exec_time) OVER())::numeric, 2) AS pct_of_total_time, rows FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query NOT ILIKE '%pg_catalog%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%information_schema%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_class%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_namespace%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_buffercache%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%Cloud_SQL_Studio%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%autovacuum%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_available_extensions%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_settings%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_database%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%ANALYZE%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_roles%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_statio%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_ls_waldir%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_current_wal%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%role_table_grants%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%heartbeat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%google_insights%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%cloudsql_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_is_in_recovery%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%password_validation%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%brute_force%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%ALTER ROLE%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%SHOW max_connections%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%validate_password%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%cloudsqladmin%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 15;

locks.lock_waits: SELECT blocked.pid AS waiting_pid, blocked.usename AS waiting_user, blocked.application_name AS waiting_app, blocked.query AS waiting_query, blocking.pid AS blocking_pid, blocking.usename AS blocking_user, blocking.query AS blocking_query, bl.locktype AS lock_type, bl.mode AS lock_mode, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - blocked.query_start))::int AS waiting_seconds FROM pg_stat_activity blocked JOIN pg_locks bl ON bl.pid = blocked.pid AND NOT bl.granted JOIN pg_locks kl ON kl.granted AND kl.locktype = bl.locktype AND kl.relation = bl.relation JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking ON blocking.pid = kl.pid WHERE blocked.pid <> blocking.pid ORDER BY waiting_seconds DESC LIMIT 10;

connections.active_connections: SELECT state, count(*) AS connection_count, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - state_change))::int) AS longest_seconds, (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections') AS max_connections_allowed, ROUND((count(*)::numeric / (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections')) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_max FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state ORDER BY connection_count DESC;
connections.aborted_connections: SELECT datname AS database_name, conflicts AS aborted_due_to_conflicts, deadlocks AS aborted_due_to_deadlocks, blk_read_time AS block_read_time_ms, blk_write_time AS block_write_time_ms FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();
connections.thread_activity: SELECT state, wait_event_type, wait_event, count(*) AS thread_count FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state, wait_event_type, wait_event ORDER BY thread_count DESC LIMIT 10;

storage.fragmentation: SELECT schemaname AS schema_name, relname AS table_name, n_live_tup AS live_rows, n_dead_tup AS dead_rows, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size, CASE WHEN (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((n_dead_tup::numeric / (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup)) * 100, 2) END AS fragmentation_pct, last_vacuum, last_autovacuum FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) > 0 ORDER BY fragmentation_pct DESC LIMIT 10;
